briefdescription.para: Defines backwards-compatible type aliases for ONNX protobuf enumerations.

detaileddescription.para: The original protobuf-generated C++ code exposed flat names such as TensorProto_DataType. The onnx-light implementation uses scoped enumerations (e.g. TensorProto::DataType). The aliases defined here restore the flat names so that code written against the original protobuf headers continues to compile without modification.
